platform: KGNU Community Radio Music Department Contact Form Inquiry Route
manual_review_reason: KGNU's official contact form offers a Music department routing option, but it is a general inquiry form protected by reCAPTCHA v3 and publishes no authorization to attach or deliver music, no file or link specifications, no release window and no metadata requirements. A human must send only a concise routing inquiry without audio files or track links, complete the CAPTCHA normally and wait for explicit delivery instructions.

platform: KAOS 89.3 FM Music Director Digital and Physical Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KAOS accepts full releases rather than singles and requires a one-sheet or press release with bio, album description, focus tracks and FCC violations or clean-edit details. Digital delivery must use streaming and download links in an email headed Music Submission, with no direct file attachments; physical delivery accepts CDs, vinyl and cassettes. A human must select a qualifying release, verify clean versions and rights, prepare the metadata package and choose one authorized route without duplicate delivery.
